preconditions.description: The number of strings n is between 1 and 30 inclusive.
The input contains exactly n strings.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) and len(s) >= 1 for s in strings)
preconditions.description: Each string in the input list is non-empty.

postconditions.expression: output == str(sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1, n + 1) if is_stable(strings[i:j])))
postconditions.description: The output is the count of all nonempty contiguous sublists of the input strings that are stable, where a sublist is stable if every message constructible from it satisfies the cyclic shift condition.
For any stable sublist X, every message formed by concatenating elements of X has exactly k cyclic shifts that are also constructible from X, where k is the number of elements concatenated.
